context: Fixed both 1.24.0 field bugs test-first: .mcp.json guard now uses bare ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} (the :- form expanded to empty via documented default-value expansion, exit 78 every session); launcher login-PATH recovery merges instead of replacing and probes well-known install dirs. 8 new tests. rationale: The guard is a deliberate 07-24 decision (01KYB2PYXW6AY4BRG3ZNVBP8XX) protecting the outside-plugin-context branch with a named exit-78 diagnostic. Bare form is the documented correct syntax for plugin .mcp.json (plugin configs substitute it directly; it is not an env var, so ${VAR:-} default expansion legitimately yielded empty). Outside a plugin context sh expands the unset var to empty and the guard still fires with the named message — every branch either launches or names the cause.
summary: Repaired the unset-root guard's syntax to bare ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} rather than removing the guard
